findings_or_gaps: test_weekly_trim_and_remove_exports_nutrients_over_500_hours in budget_tracking.rs does not zero DIC shortcut rates (unlike close_budget_gas_exchange). It currently passes because the committed ProcessParams::default() DIC rates are already non-zero and the test's budget tracking tolerates them. However, uncommitted parallel work (bead 6e5.4.7 photosynthesis DIC changes in algae_growth.rs/plant_growth.rs) breaks this test with a 52.5 mg carbon imbalance at tick 23. When that parallel work lands, this test will need its DIC shortcuts zeroed — the same pattern as the close_budget_gas_exchange fix from amendment fr-2-7a419098.

The water change e2e fixture does not set a non-zero source nitrite value (source.nitrite_mg_n_per_l defaults to 0.0 from SourceWaterProfile::zero()), so while the expected_n_import formula correctly includes the nitrite term, it is not actually exercised with a non-zero value. This is a minor coverage gap, not a correctness issue.
